summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 correct the public tender offer (started 4 August 2026) for JPMC shares following JFTC approval (4 August 2026) and grant of shortened prohibition period (5 August 2026). Correction pertains to withdrawal conditions under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
title_en: Notice Regarding Correction of Public Tender Offer Commencement Announcement Accompanying Submission of Corrected Public Tender Offer Report by Amsterdam1 Co., Ltd. and Amsterdam2 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2, acting as co-offerors in a take-private transaction, filed a corrected public tender offer report on 6 August 2026 for JPMC shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (Code 3276). The correction followed receipt on 5 August 2026 of two notices from the Japan Fair Trade Commission dated 4 August 2026: a clearance notice (no exclusionary order) and a notice granting a shortened prohibition period. The tender offer commenced on 4 August 2026. The correction concerns withdrawal conditions under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (FIEA) and associated rules. The offerors note that this correction does not constitute a change in purchase terms or conditions as defined under FIEA Article 27-3(2)(1). The specific amendment details (marked with underlines in the original) relate to procedural provisions governing tender offer withdrawal rights.
